capabilities: Sync memos from a Memos server into a vault folder
Download and embed memo attachments (images and files)
Generate optional AI summaries, tags, and weekly digests
Filter syncing by date and per-sync limit, manually or on an interval
Download resources via the classic {base}o/r/{id}/{filename} URL pattern
disambiguation: Not Obsidian Sync-style device syncing; it pulls notes from a self-hosted Memos app into the vault.
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installation is manual (copying main.js and manifest.json into the plugins folder). Only supports Memos v0.21 and earlier; for v0.22+ the README directs users to the original plugin or another fork.
intentEvidence: A fork of leoleelxh/obsidian-memos-ai-sync by erbanku, updated to support Memos v0.21 and earlier API.
problem: The original plugin only supports the newer Memos gRPC-gateway API, so users running Memos v0.21 or earlier cannot sync their memos into Obsidian.

relations.evidence: A fork of leoleelxh/obsidian-memos-ai-sync by erbanku, updated to support Memos v0.21 and earlier API.
obsidian-memos-sync-plugin, sync Memos content to Obsidian with AI enhancement.

summary: Fork of obsidian-memos-ai-sync that syncs notes from a self-hosted Memos instance (v0.21 or earlier API) into the vault, with optional AI summaries, tags, and weekly digests.
